rationale: Current wins are concentrated in the two-block recurrent tail and the FP16 rescue on recurrent Q/K, while the earlier MLP-only recurrence lost and recent full-block tail tweaks plateaued. This keeps the best recurrent-tail + FP16-QK setup but narrows the repeated pass to mixed-input plus attention only, preserving the zero-init gated carry while removing recurrent MLP compute/noise so the 600-second Mac mini budget can buy more useful steps for the final exact int8+zlib roundtrip metric.
title: Attention-Only Recurrent Tail On QK-Rescued Best
